data.one_liner: Flutter widget for lazy, draggable, reorderable staggered grid layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides ReorderableStaggeredGridView and items that can be dragged to change order. Supports lazy building and customizable drag behavior.
use_when: You need a staggered grid where users can reorder items via drag‑and‑drop
Large collections where lazy loading improves performance
You want customizable drag feedback and animation
avoid_when: A static grid without reordering is needed
You require automatic order handling without manual state updates
strengths: Lazy construction for large data sets
weaknesses: Developer must manually update item list on drop
Requires GlobalKey on children to preserve state

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides staggered grid layouts without reordering; simpler if drag‑and‑drop isn’t needed
